text:
mira: Quick FYI — planning a small maintenance rollout tonight 23:00–23:40 UTC. Targets: a micro cohort of GPU nodes in az3 (pools: saturn, zephyr). Scope: NIC micro-firmware + kernel module reload. Low-risk but will cordon/drain a handful at a time.

alex: Acknowledged. What's the expected TPS impact?

mira: Expect ~2–4% transient capacity drop while each node drains. We'll stagger at 1 node every 3 minutes to keep latency SLOs. Autoscaling + backfill will kick in.

sujeet: Can we pre-seed KV cache after each node comes back? Last time cold start hit 200ms p99.

mira: Yes — plan includes prefix cache warmup job post-uncordon. Sequence: cordon -> drain -> apply fw -> reboot -> uncordon -> kv-seed job.

jen: Do we need a canary? Recommend 2 nodes first on non-prod pool then roll.

mira: Agreed. Canary on saturn-cohort-A (2 nodes) at 23:00. Hold for 10m health checks (latency p99, error rate, GPU utilization). If stable, continue cohort-by-cohort.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT BOT: Reminder: oncall rota — @alex is primary for 22:30–02:30 UTC. Use /incident if customer impact > 5% capacity.

alex: I'll be monitoring. Please surface any sudden error regression.

mira: Routing/fallback: traffic will prefer eu-west variants if capacity drops >8% in az3. Smart routing policy already set in traffic-config for this window.

sujeet: Cost question — rolling drains cause transient burst of additional nodes from autoscaler. Estimate?

mira: Back-of-envelope: 8 extra vGPUs for ~40m across the window -> ~0.7 instance-hours. Tagging: we'll attach cost-center=infra-maint and ticket=OPS-439 so finance can reconcile.

jen: Customer comms? Any external notices?

mira: No customer-facing outage expected. We'll post a short note to status page if observed degradation. Internal comms in #customer-success just in case.

alex: One more thing — ensure SSH access to the reboots' serial logs for a quick triage. Last event needed dmesg.

mira: Good call. opsplaybook snippet added to the runbook:```ssh jump@rack-bmc-{{node}} sudo journalctl -k -b -1```

sujeet: If we see NIC flapping on revert, rollback plan?

mira: Rollback: reapply previous firmware image, reboot, mark node as no-pool for 30m and exclude from routing. We'll halt the rollout and escalate to @jen + hw-team.

jen: I'll be on standby for escalation.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC -> 23:40 UTC. ID: maint-20260321-micro1. Notifying oncall and posting to internal calendar.

alex: Sounds good. I'll watch metrics and call rollback if errors spike. :thumbsup:

mira: Thanks all — running preflight checks at 22:30 UTC. I'll post the canary results in this thread.

sujeet: Thx.
